fusions.name: Gathered Charge
fusions.desc: Sends a bolt that deals 7 damage. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Clean Sweep
fusions.desc: Sweeps a cone 7 tiles long ahead of you, dealing 26 damage to everything in it. The sweep ignores armour.

fusions.name: Gleaned Wind
fusions.desc: Increases your stamina recovery by 50% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Gleaning
fusions.desc: When you run out of stamina, you regain 20 stamina. Once every 30 seconds.
